patch_description: Seed the nonlinear solver with deterministic unequal radii correlated with the finite-row topology.  Corner-adjacent circles receive a modest radius advantage, while circles in the densest six-circle rows receive a slight penalty.  This breaks the artificial equal-radius basin before contacts are established and better reflects the boundary defects expected in strong finite square packings.  The radii remain deliberately small relative to initial separations, so all starts are feasible without requiring an unreliable repair before optimization.
